Among them, our pride is the rare "Ozaki beef," which is shipped only 30 heads per month. It is characterized by a lower melting point of fat compared to regular beef, making it light and refreshing. Please enjoy the exquisite taste that melts in your mouth. Additionally, all of our sauces that enhance the flavor of the meat are homemade. Enjoy the combination of our carefully crafted sauces, such as miso, lemon, and soy sauce, with a variety of cuts! 次へ 前へ Space "Refreshing the Indoor Air Every 3.5 Minutes for Your Peace of Mind" In our stylish interior, which is primarily black, we offer a variety of rooms in different sizes. All rooms are completely private, allowing you to enjoy your meal without worrying about those around you, whether you are dining alone or with friends. Of course, it’s also perfect for dates or meals with friends. The calm atmosphere is ideal for important business meetings as well. Families with children can relax comfortably, so you can enjoy quality time together. We look forward to welcoming everyone to our space filled with a sense of privacy. 次へ 前へ Food "Our Specialty: 'Wagyu Tsurami Sashimi' with a Focus on Freshness!" Our shop, which handles exceptionally fresh meat, highly recommends "raw items"! Among them, our top recommended dish, "Wagyu Tsurami Sashimi," is a delightful treat that pairs perfectly with drinks. It comes topped with green onions, seaweed, sesame, and more, along with a refreshing special sauce, so please enjoy it wrapped up! Additionally, Tsurami is also exquisite when grilled! Its firm texture and rich, deep flavor are truly addictive. We offer both salt and sauce, so feel free to choose according to your preference. 次へ 前へ Food "Indulge in the Exquisite Flavor of 'Yakisuki' and Satisfy Your Body and Soul" "Yaki-suki" is a dish where thinly sliced sukiyaki beef is quickly seared and then dipped in raw egg before eating. The perfect balance of the meat's sweetness, enhanced by the marbling, and the creaminess of the egg creates an exquisite flavor that leaves many craving for more after just one taste! Additionally, after enjoying the meat, it's highly recommended to add "white rice for egg mixing." Pouring the leftover egg from the plate over the rice allows you to savor every bit of the deliciousness!
